about.badge: About Dr. Al Hasan Al Saiem
about.title: Expertise That Merges
about.description: Dr. Al Hasan Al Saiem is a board-certified aesthetic and plastic surgeon with over 15 years of experience transforming the lives of thousands of patients through natural, refined results. Specialized in face & neck lift, rhinoplasty, liposuction & fat injection, and all advanced aesthetic procedures.

procedures.title: Our
procedures.subtitle: We offer a comprehensive range of advanced aesthetic procedures designed to deliver natural, refined results.
procedures.blepharoplastyDesc: Rejuvenating the eyes by lifting the upper eyelid for a more youthful appearance
procedures.faceNeckLiftDesc: Restoring youth and vitality to the face and neck with the latest advanced lifting techniques
procedures.rhinoplastyDesc: Sculpting and reshaping the nose to achieve ideal harmony with facial features
procedures.liposuctionFatDesc: Body contouring and removal of stubborn fat with fat reinjection in desired areas
procedures.tummyTuckDesc: Abdominoplasty for a flatter, more toned and contoured abdomen
procedures.botoxDesc: Smoothing facial wrinkles and achieving a natural youthful look with advanced Botox
procedures.fillersDesc: Volume restoration, skin hydration, and natural facial feature enhancement
procedures.armThighLiftDesc: Lifting and contouring the arms for a slimmer, more toned appearance
procedures.breastSurgeryDesc: Reshaping, lifting and reducing the breasts for a natural, proportional look
procedures.scarRevisionDesc: Improving and minimizing the appearance of scars and deformities with the latest techniques

informationCard.title: What every woman needs to know before cosmetic surgery
informationCard.content: Before considering any cosmetic procedure, it's important to understand every stage, the recovery period, and realistic expectations. Our team guides you step by step with complete honesty and transparency.

testimonials.title: What Our
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from patients who experienced exceptional care with us.
testimonials.t1Text: My experience with Dr. Al Hasan Al Saiem was exceptional. The results exceeded my expectations by far, and the care from the entire team was outstanding. I highly recommend him to anyone considering a cosmetic procedure.
testimonials.t2Text: After years of consideration, I finally decided on a rhinoplasty procedure. Dr. Al Hasan Al Saiem made the entire experience comfortable and easy, and the results look completely natural. No one could tell!
testimonials.t3Text: The professionalism and attention to detail at Dr. Al Hasan Al Saiem's practice is unmatched. I feel youthful again and my confidence has been fully restored.

faq.title: Frequently
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most commonly asked questions about our procedures and services.
faq.q1: How do I know which procedure is right for me?
faq.a1: We offer a comprehensive free consultation where Dr. Al Hasan Al Saiem evaluates your needs and explains all available options. Every treatment plan is personalized for each patient.
faq.q2: How long is the recovery period?
faq.a2: Recovery duration varies by procedure. Generally, most patients return to normal activities within 1-2 weeks. We provide detailed post-procedure care instructions.
faq.a3: Absolutely. We specialize in achieving natural results that enhance your features without altering your appearance. Our goal is to bring out the best version of you.
faq.a4: Safety is our top priority. We use the latest internationally certified equipment and techniques. Dr. Al Hasan Al Saiem holds certifications from the world's most prestigious medical societies.
faq.a5: We accept various payment methods and offer flexible payment plans. All financial details can be discussed during your initial consultation.
faq.q6: Can I see results similar to my case?
faq.a6: Absolutely! We have a comprehensive gallery of before-and-after photos for a wide range of procedures.
